svg.title: UML Deployment Diagram - JobPortal BD (what the repository confirms about runtime)

g.text: UML Deployment Diagram - JobPortal BD (what the repository confirms about runtime)
Static asset host / Vite dev server
Whether web host, application host and database host are the same machine,
separate servers or managed services (e.g. a hosted MongoDB) cannot be
determined. server.js sets DNS resolvers 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1, which suggests
a DNS-based (possibly SRV) MongoDB connection string, but this is an inference only.
Credentials for MongoDB, Cloudinary, SMTP and JWT come from environment variables
(Server/.env, excluded by .gitignore). Values are intentionally not documented.
Artifacts, connections and ports : confirmed by code, scripts or configuration
«unconfirmed host» : the machine or service hosting this part cannot be
Dashed arrows : supporting relationships (serving, one-off seeding)
The repository contains NO Dockerfile, docker-compose, CI/CD workflow,
hosting manifest (Vercel, Netlify, Render, Procfile ...) or deployment documentation.
